lists.title: Nearest of each kind
lists.method: From Star View’s catalogs and compact-object overlay, by each object’s type, spectral class and luminosity class.

lists.title: Closest stellar encounters
lists.method: Straight-line motion from today’s positions and space velocities in Star View’s catalogs, for closest approaches within 2 million years. Stars without a radial velocity are not included.

lists.title: Highest proper motion
lists.method: From Star View’s catalogs; one entry per star system.

lists.title: Metal-poor and metal-rich stars
lists.method: Spectroscopic [Fe/H] of F- to M-type stars in Star View’s catalogs, confirmed by a second paper within 0.3 dex. Hotter stars are left out: their surface abundances reflect atomic diffusion rather than their composition.

lists.title: Planets
lists.method: Confirmed planets of stars in Star View’s catalogs, with measured values only. The habitable zone is the conservative zone of Kopparapu et al. (2014) drawn in each system diagram.
